EEGNETV4.checkpoint_rule: Only the final model state at the fixed update budget is used. No best-Validation checkpoint selection.
EEGNETV4.optimization_budget_rule: Use a fixed number of optimizer updates for every training condition. The budget equals 24 complete epochs over the 47,835-window Real Train set using the original EEGNetv4 baseline batch size. For larger augmented datasets, cycle/reshuffle the loader only until the same update budget is reached. Validation must NOT be used for early stopping or checkpoint selection.
EEGNETV4.recipe: Reuse the exact previously established EEGNetv4 architecture, optimizer family, batch size, and fixed non-budget hyperparameters. No architecture or hyperparameter tuning is allowed during utility experiments.

LOGBANDPOWER_LOGREG.learned_preprocessing_rule: Any learned feature scaling must be fit only on that condition's training data and then applied unchanged to Validation/Test.
LOGBANDPOWER_LOGREG.recipe: Reuse the exact previously established real-only LogBandpower + LogisticRegression implementation and fixed hyperparameters. No new hyperparameter search is allowed.
LOGBANDPOWER_LOGREG.threshold_rule: fixed classifier default decision threshold; no threshold tuning

OAS_RIEMANN_LINEAR_SVM.learned_preprocessing_rule: OAS/covariance transforms, reference geometry, tangent-space mapping, and any feature scaling must be fit only on that condition's training data.
OAS_RIEMANN_LINEAR_SVM.recipe: Reuse the exact previously established OAS/Riemannian + linear-SVM implementation and fixed hyperparameters. No new hyperparameter search is allowed.
OAS_RIEMANN_LINEAR_SVM.threshold_rule: fixed zero decision boundary; no threshold tuning

Validation.role: development-only utility evaluation; not an independent final performance estimate

data_handling_rules.normalization: the same frozen Train-only global 19-channel mean/std used by Scenario 2; no per-subject, per-state, or per-window normalization
data_handling_rules.subject_id_use: allowed only for subject-stratified synthetic matching, bookkeeping, and subject-macro evaluation
data_handling_rules.subject_state_pool_matching: For each frozen subject and eye state, synthetic 1x count must equal the number of usable eligible Real Train windows in that exact subject-state stratum.

opening_preconditions: B1 1x synthetic pool complete and integrity-verified
B2 1x synthetic pool complete and integrity-verified
all utility classifier artifacts for every predeclared condition frozen
no condition is added, removed, or retuned based on Validation performance
final-test execution script records hashes of every frozen input artifact
final_test_policy.rule: All final classifiers remain trained only on the frozen Real Train and/or frozen synthetic Train pools. Validation is development-only. The same frozen classifier artifacts are evaluated on Final Test.

historical_real_only_validation_anchors.note: Historical development anchors only; not pass/fail thresholds for the new utility experiment.

no_tuning_rules: Do not retrain, reselect, or modify frozen B1.
Do not retrain, reselect, or modify frozen B2.
Do not add a new generator after s2_72.
Do not add a 2x synthetic ratio after seeing utility results.
Do not generate a separate 0.5x diffusion pool.
Do not tune classifier hyperparameters on the new utility Validation results.
Do not use Validation for EEGNet early stopping/checkpoint selection.
Do not drop an unfavorable predeclared condition before Final Test.
Do not use subject identity as a classifier input feature.
Do not fit any learned transform or scaler on Validation or Test.
Do not access Final Test until all preconditions are satisfied.

primary_comparisons.interpretation: Does the selected B2 generator provide more class-relevant synthetic-only training data than B1?
Does 1x B2 synthetic augmentation improve the primary downstream classifier over real-only training?
Does B2 provide better augmentation utility than B1 at the same synthetic-data ratio?

scientific_question: Evaluate whether frozen subject+state-conditioned synthetic EEG transfers to real eye-state classification and whether B2 has better downstream utility than B1.

statistics.EEGNET_seed_aggregation: For each condition, compute metrics separately for all 3 frozen training seeds and report mean +/- population SD. For paired condition comparisons, each bootstrap replicate resamples subjects, recomputes the metric for each matched EEGNet seed, averages across the 3 seeds, and then takes the paired condition difference.
statistics.directional_positive_rule: If the point estimate is above 0 but the paired 95% CI includes 0, report directional positive evidence, not a definitive improvement.
statistics.strong_positive_evidence_rule: For a predeclared primary comparison, call the evidence strong positive only if the paired 95% bootstrap CI for the primary subject-macro BA difference is entirely above 0.

synthetic_generation.common_rng_scope: entire ancestral reverse-sampling RNG stream for each matched subject-state shard
synthetic_generation.half_subset_rule: For every subject-state stratum with n samples in the frozen 1x pool, use floor(n/2) indices from a deterministic permutation. The exact same retained pool indices are used for B1 and B2.
synthetic_generation.reason_for_no_2x: The 1x pool already supports TSTR, full 1x augmentation, and nested 0.5x augmentation. A 2x pool would approximately double diffusion generation cost and is not required for the predeclared primary B1-vs-B2 utility questions.

storage.format: one compressed NPZ shard per generator x subject x eye_state
storage.resume_rule: A completed shard may be reused only if its metadata, expected shape, sample count, generator hash, and file SHA256 agree with its manifest. A partial or unverifiable shard must be regenerated from its predeclared subject-state seed.

synthetic_generation.subject_state_count_matching: For each frozen subject and eye state, synthetic 1x count must equal the number of usable eligible Real Train windows in that exact subject-state stratum.

utility_conditions.role: size/weighting sanity control; adds no new EEG information

validation_role: Development evidence and implementation sanity only. Because B2 selection already used Validation evidence, new Validation utility numbers must not be presented as independent final performance estimates.
